recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is indicated unless future tooling reintroduces generated resource-questionnaires and reproduces Signature datatype handling failures.
issue_request: FHIR-5910 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 tooling correction reporting: "Questionnaire Generation Failed: Unhandled Data Type: Signature on element Provenance.signature".
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-5910, but the old Java QuestionnaireBuilder contained the reported failure path and commit c34b8e6b2406cb95e5516d6a7e2de6bdc2fa11bb added Signature to the handled/ignored datatype list before the Jira comments marked the issue sorted on 2015-03-31.
additional_context: Provenance and Questionnaire are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini, and the current Provenance StructureDefinition defines Provenance.signature with type Signature. The current checkout no longer contains the obsolete QuestionnaireBuilder, Questionnaire Generation Failed publisher log, or Unhandled Data Type source path. Jira exact-error search found only FHIR-5910; exact Zulip/Confluence searches and Confluence Jira-reference search found no relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Made no source change and published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch, because the historical tooling defect was already applied and the current authoritative source remains correct.
